title: How to Install the Base for X Series
body_html:
What is the Riser Base (Base Boost™)?

The Riser Base (Base Boost™) is a precision-engineered add-on for the OneLaser X Series that expands your machine’s versatility and workflow. Designed for makers who work with taller objects like 40oz tumblers, bottles, or large décor pieces, the Riser Base elevates your laser to provide extra clearance height and straight-through pass access up to 160mm.

Beyond size flexibility, the Base Boost™ helps create a cleaner, dust-free, and safer workspace by improving air circulation and debris management. Whether you’re engraving large products or running production batches, Base Boost™ ensures stability, precision, and efficiency—all in one sleek upgrade.
